content: We got many templates. Need one that corresponds to SN2: breaking halide, forming amine (C-N). The functional groups broken halide, formed amine (primary/secondary/tertiary). Actually there is no halide in molecule. But retrosynthesis: we need to break a C-N bond to form a halide precursor? The forward SN2 forms C-N and breaks C-Cl. So retrosynthetic step: disconnect C-N to give a halide (e.g., alkyl chloride) and amine nucleophile. So we need template that breaks C-N (amine) and forms halide. So functional_groups_broken: amine? Actually broken functional group is halide (in forward). In retrosynthesis, we break C-N (the formed amine) to get halide. So we should search for templates where functional_groups_broken includes amine (primary/secondary/tertiary) and functional_groups_formed includes halide. Let's search.
